static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.educational_background: Currently studying for a bachelor's degree
static_traits.social_status: 有Female友与几位退伍军人同伴可交流，但其认为他们not yet必能充分理解其面临的Academic pressure
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet出现类似的学业Anxiety；without既往心理治疗/咨询史；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，逻辑性好，能自我Reflection认知模式；配合度高，语气诚恳；情绪紧张但可控

basic_info.main_problem: 在一次作业拿到较差成绩后，我对学业表现感到overwhelmed与Anxiety，害怕失败并被学校劝退。这种恐惧自事件后愈发强烈，几乎每天困扰，尤其在考试前或Receiving grades时，已影响到我的动力与自信。
basic_info.core_demands: The fear of failure and its impact on my mental health and academic performance prompted me to seek counseling support.
growth_experiences: After entering school as a veteran, felt strong pressure 'to perform well' from the very start (occurring before this difference event).
Family-of-origin information: father once served in the military.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/not适合这门学业
My worth depends on grades and others' expectations (failure equals disappointing my family)

special_situations.event: 收到一次作业的差成绩
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次作业考差，说明我not适合这门学业，接下来会挂科
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍学习、向教授求助、use放松技巧来降低Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我很快会被学校劝退/挂科

special_situations.event: Before exams or while waiting for results
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这次考not好，就证明I will fail并让家人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing review intensity and trying relaxation techniques, while repeatedly envisioning the worst outcome in order to 'be prepared'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will most likely be bad; I might fail the course

special_situations.event: 想到家人的期待与评价
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若达not到高标准，就会让家人失望，说明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Studying harder, seeking help from professors to meet others' expectations

special_situations.event: 在自我评估能力时回顾个do not挫折（如一次差分）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要有一次失败，就证明我根本not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Develops thoughts of giving up to avoid the blow of failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not是这块料/我not适合读这个

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过稳定的学业表现Gaining recognition与安心，特do not是被家人接纳与肯定
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败、被negate与让家人失望，从而被视为not值得或not够好
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of failure and criticism by doubling efforts and imagining the worst outcome in advance

object_relations.self_representation: 可能失败、会让重要他人失望的Student
object_relations.object_representation: Family members/significant others with high expectations of oneself who may be disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing 'what one bad grade means' or being asked about views on failure
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向于把一次挫折理解为“整体失败”，仿佛have not中间地带
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以绝对化词语（如“一定”“全都”“完全not行”）描述自我与结果，语气紧绷，忽略部分成功或改进空间。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When approaching exams or waiting for results to be announced
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes imagining the worst case in advance can 'prepare' oneself to avoid the blow
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 反复描述最坏结果及应急方案，用“如果这次not行就完了”的句式，语速略快、关注not yet来威胁而非当下证据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about family expectations or being asked about worries over family reactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将可能对外的失望与not满Turning against the self，Reinforcement自责与Self-denial
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责与贬低自我为主的表述（如“都是我not好”“我让他们失望”），降低自我价值，语气内疚。

manifestations: 感觉Female友与退伍同伴并not能完全理解其Academic pressure与处境
The role transition from military to campus brings a sense of adaptation gap

contact_model.definition: 个体Has poor self-reflection and introspection, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁以自责与绝对化方式评价自己（如“我not适合”“I will fail”）
Treats a single setback as proof of overall ability, lowers the sense of self-worth

positive_force: 主动寻求支持（向教授求助、use放松技巧）
具备一定的自我观察与认知Reflection能力（能识do not“跳到结论”“灾难化”）
Willing to try behavioral experiments and cognitive restructuring
拥有一定社会支持（Female友与退伍同伴）
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, and overgeneralization are significant
Sensitive to external evaluation; worries about disappointing family
持续性担忧导致Impaired sleep and attention
挫折后Decreased motivation并出现放弃倾向

target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的灾难化认知及对让家人失望的担忧Reinforcement了威胁评估
target_behavior.function: 通过预先担忧来获得对not确定性的“控制感”，试图避免再次失败
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disturbance、Decreased attention与Anxiety worsened，进一步损害学业表现

复盘个do not差分时对自我能力作极端判断
